note: The opening `"` at the inline-pair key position never finds a matching unescaped closing `"` before end-of-line, so it swallows the rest of the line -- including what would otherwise have been the compound's own closing `}`. The bracket-balance check behind UnterminatedInlineCompound is itself quote-opaque (Sec 5.3.3's Inline pairs bullet), so this is UnterminatedInlineCompound, NOT UnterminatedQuotedKey (Sec 6.16): that category only covers ordinary multi-line pair lines with no enclosing bracket needing its own same-line closer.
